faqs.question: Can the high bay withstand Middle East summer temperatures?
faqs.answer: Yes. Rated for 50°C ambient temperature. The aluminum housing and thermal design ensure stable operation even in GCC summer conditions. Yakeen Lighting provides thermal test data.

faqs.question: What is the recommended mounting height?
faqs.answer: 100W: 4-6m, 150W: 6-9m, 200W: 8-12m, 240W: 10-15m. We provide free DIALux simulation to calculate exact lux levels for your space.
